test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

The chief guest gave out prizes to the meritorious students of the school.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the phrase "**gave out prizes**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**gave away prizes**," which is more commonly used and accepted in standard English.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The chief guest **gave away prizes** to the meritorious students of the school."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1) "of the school."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2) "The chief guest"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3) "to the meritorious students"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
